items.label: 3-Tier Storage Spaces console table
items.value: The 3-tier narrow console table includes 2 dense mesh shelves and 2 spacious non-woven fabric drawers below the wooden tabletop. 2-tier open shelf design allows you to place books, vases, DVDs, storage boxes, etc. assuring your desktop is more tidy and satisfying your various needs

items.label: Multifunctional Entryway Table
items.value: Measuring 29.5"L x 9.4"W x 29.5"H, the narrow entryway table with 2 drawers can be placed in the living room, hallway, bedroom to store books, plants or ornaments. In the kitchen, it can keep the coffee maker, juicer or grain storage boxes etc.

items.label: Stable Console Table
items.value: The black metal frame with quality particleboard plus the mesh shelves cast a firm sofa table. The tabletop of this entryway table can load up to 88 lb and each mesh shelf 33 lb. 4 adjustable feet level the console table on various floors without scratches

items.label: Modern Style
items.value: Black metal frame combined with rustic brown wooden panels can go well with many different colors. The entryway table with 3-tier storage shelves will let your study or bedroom more charming

items.label: Quick to Assemble
items.value: Each part of behind couch sofa table the is clearly labeled and the instruction manual is comprehensible to eliminate the guesswork. You won’t go wrong
